title: Mitigating Language Bias in Cross-Lingual Job Retrieval: A Recruitment Platform Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the disparity in language preference during cross-lingual retrieval using a novel metric called Language Bias Kullback-Leibler Divergence (LBKL), which compares the distribution of language proportions between the ground truth and the predicted list for each query, alongside visualizing language frequency histograms of retrieved candidates.
